title: Amber pearl
content:
# Amber pearl

Type: Valuable | Internal ID: AmberPearl | Source: Burial Chambers, Troll Cave, Sunken Crypts, Stone Grave, Viking Graveyard | Usage: Selling to a, Trader | Sell: 10, Coins | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Amber pearl is a Valuable item.

## Availability

• Stone Grave and Viking Graveyard in the Meadows
• Burial Chambers and Troll Caves in the Black Forest
• Sunken Crypts in the Swamp
• Amber pearl can be obtained from Fishing, as a bonus drop when catching Pike.

### Crafting

• Celebratory cap

### Selling

• As a valuable, it can be sold to any of the traders for 10 Coins.

Categorias: Valuables
